name: Zitadel
description: Zitadel is a complete identity and access management platform built on Go and CockroachDB. It covers OIDC, SAML, social logins, MFA, and a management API, positioning itself as a modern alternative to Auth0 or Keycloak that you can run yourself.
highlights: OIDC, SAML, and social login out of the box
Admin console with a full management API
curatorNote: Identity is the hardest part of any product, and Zitadel makes it a checkbox instead of a project. Self-hosting auth is finally realistic.
